title: Claude managed plugin scope decides over every other scope and is never updated (ADR Amendment 6, ruling 28)
description: opum-doc ADR distribute-lore-and-quest-agent-skills-through-the-plugin-marketplace.md, Amendment 6, ruling 28 (ODOC-286, opum-doc commit 44326c5, opum-ai/opum-doc#458, on main 7818aca), read directly at 7818aca. The order becomes managed > local > project > user > synced. Ruling 28 supersedes ruling 26(ii) for managed only: managed is administrator policy the user cannot override, so a lower scope must never be reported as the one that decides. A managed deciding row is NEVER updated: no --scope managed update runs, the state is reported with scope: managed, and the remedy names the administrator managed settings instead of a command the user can run. That holds for the installed remedy, the disabled enable remedy, and agents --update-instructions, which must report update not-run. The amendment Disposition names QCLI-371 (merged 30a6846) as ranking managed below user; today claudeScopePrecedence in src/adapters/agents/cli-agent-plugins.ts is [local, project, user, managed, synced]. MEASUREMENT LIMIT, as the amendment records: no managed row has been observed from a real claude plugin list; the schema is read from the Claude Code 2.1.283 binary, where the install-scope enum includes managed and user and managed rows apply to every project. lore-cli owes the same ruling, so the managed remedy string must be agreed with lore-cli under ruling (d). Touches the same decoder as QCLI-379 (the within-scope depth tie-break): land that first or rebase onto it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: claude rows rank managed > local > project > user > synced: an applicable managed row decides over an enabled or disabled row of any other scope, in either list order
A managed deciding row is reported with scope managed, its remedy names the administrator managed settings (the text agreed with lore-cli), and no remedy or argv ever carries --scope managed
agents --update-instructions --target claude with a managed deciding row runs nothing beyond the list and reports update not-run, proven by a fake runtime that logs every call
